name: Admin Proposal Update From JSON
description: Re-import a complete JSON payload over an existing proposal from /panel/proposals/:id/edit. Pastes/uploads JSON → PUT /proposals/:id/update-from-json/ replaces metadata and section content_json. Different from admin-proposal-create-from-json (creation): targets an existing proposal id, supports keeping expires_at unchanged on expired proposals, and surfaces unknown-key warnings.
knownGaps: Happy path only; unknown-key warnings surfacing and keep-expires_at-on-expired branch unasserted (2026-07 audit).
